description: Visualize financial data in a report. Open /home/ga/Documents/sales_report.odt which contains a table of 'Regional Revenue'. You must: (1) Select the data table (including headers), (2) Insert a Chart (Insert > Chart), (3) Configure the chart as a 'Column' or 'Bar' chart, (4) Set the Chart Title to '2024 Regional Revenue Trends', (5) Set the X-Axis label to 'Region' and Y-Axis label to 'Revenue ($M)', (6) Position the chart immediately below the data table so it does not obscure text. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/sales_report_final.odt.
